about: Named generation recipes for mw.py gen. 'params' are defaults; override with --cfg/--steps/--sampler/--scheduler/--shift/--planner or --set '{json}'. Each recipe says where its numbers came from. Add a recipe only after a run that a listener judged.

acestep-xl-sft.use: default for instrumentals 30 s to 4 min: game beds, themes, solos, film movements
acestep-xl-sft.timing: about 80-100 s per 180 s track on a 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti once loaded; peaks about 12.9 GB VRAM
acestep-xl-sft.source: listener-approved batches (bright melodic electronica with flute leads, 2026-08); cfg 7 sounded harsh to that listener, cfg 4.5 did not. The 1.7B planner sits beside the 10 GB DiT on 16 GB far better than the 4B one.

acestep-xl-sft-classic.use: the ComfyUI template defaults; firmer adherence, harsher top end. Try when 4.5 drifts off the caption.
acestep-xl-sft-classic.timing: 10-minute tracks take about 9.5-10 minutes on a 16 GB card
acestep-xl-sft-classic.source: ComfyUI's ACE-Step 1.5 XL template; used for long-form and short film cues 2026-08 to 2026-10

minimax-music3.model: MiniMax Music 3 (open weights, MiniMax-Music3 Community License: free commercial use under USD 20M yearly revenue, show 'MiniMax-Music3' in the product, disclose AI output)
minimax-music3.use: second opinion for songs and long instrumentals; caption as three headings (Global Metadata, Vocal Details, Arrangement with a minute timeline)
minimax-music3.timing: 3-7 min per take typical; takes came back shorter than asked (98-170 s for 180-195 s); one 240 s beatless request hung over an hour. Use --timeout and render longer than needed.
minimax-music3.source: ComfyUI audio_minimax_music_3 template; album attempt 2026-08 (quality never judged by a listener)

acestep-rest.model: ACE-Step 1.5 2B turbo + 5Hz LM planner through the ACE-Step REST server (MIT)
acestep-rest.use: fast drafts (a 60 s take in about 22 s once warm) and the tasks ComfyUI core lacks: cover, repaint, extend, extract
acestep-rest.timing: 60 s -> 22 s, 120 s -> 31 s warm; the first request after server start loads models for about 2.5 min (submit timeout 900 s)
acestep-rest.source: measured 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-12 on a 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti
